info.title: accesU API
info.description:
Accessible indoor navigation for an Algerian university campus.

Coordinates are local campus metres (x → east, y → north), GeoJSON uses [x, y]. Times are ISO-8601 UTC; the campus runs on Africa/Algiers (UTC+1). Labels follow `?lang=ar|fr|en` or `Accept-Language` (default fr).

Live updates: Socket.io namespace `/live` (see README).

patch.description:

Writes the proposed changes (optionally adjusted in `apply`) to the NavEdge. Routing reloads the graph and routes through the passage receive `route:invalidated`.

get.description:
impact = disabled-student passes/week × stuck-or-blocked rate × detour (m, step-free way around; 300 m if none); score = 100 × (1 − e^(−impact/1500))

**Roles:** ADMIN

get.summary: My consent and the current policy
get.description: Privacy by design (Law 18-07): opt-in; inside the campus geofence only; daily-rotating pseudonym, no user id stored with movements; auto-stop on leaving campus, after 3 h and at midnight; raw data deleted after 30 days; admins see k-anonymous aggregates (≥ 5 people).

post.description: Send the policy version that was shown. 409 POLICY_OUTDATED if it is not the current one.

policyVersion.description: The version shown to the user

delete.description: Ends any running session (CONSENT_WITHDRAWN). With `deleteData=true` also deletes the data still linkable to you; otherwise the response offers it.

parameters.name: deleteData
parameters.description: Also delete the data still linkable to you (last 30 days)

delete.description: Deletes every session (points, reports) recorded under your pseudonyms of the last 30 days. Works with or without consent.

post.description:
Privacy by design (Law 18-07): opt-in; inside the campus geofence only; daily-rotating pseudonym, no user id stored with movements; auto-stop on leaving campus, after 3 h and at midnight; raw data deleted after 30 days; admins see k-anonymous aggregates (≥ 5 people).

Ends any session already running. Requires consent to the current policy.

needsCategory.description: Coarse category only. Default: from your accessibility profile.

get.description: Today’s latest session: ACTIVE (with a reminder during the last 15 minutes) or ENDED with the reason (left campus, 3 h, midnight…).

post.description: Dropped: accuracy > 10 m, outside the session window, positioning jumps (> 3 m/s). The first point outside the campus geofence ends the session (GEOFENCE_EXIT) and is not stored. Positions are smoothed (accuracy-weighted).
BLOCKED, TOO_STEEP or HARD_TO_NAVIGATE, attached to the nearest passage. STUCK and REROUTED are detected automatically.

get.summary: List reservations in a time range

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Default: from + 7 days. Max range 31 days.

post.description:
Intervals are half-open [startsAt, endsAt): back-to-back sessions are allowed, any overlap in the same room is a 409 `RESERVATION_CONFLICT` listing the conflicting reservations in `error.details.conflicts`. Duration 15 min – 12 h.

Teachers create TEACHER (under their own name) or CLUB reservations; only admins create ADMIN ones.

**Roles:** TEACHER, ADMIN, CLUB

patch.description:
Intervals are half-open [startsAt, endsAt): back-to-back sessions are allowed, any overlap in the same room is a 409 `RESERVATION_CONFLICT` listing the conflicting reservations in `error.details.conflicts`. Duration 15 min – 12 h.

Teachers can change only their own reservations; admins any. Ended reservations are read-only.

**Roles:** TEACHER, ADMIN, CLUB

delete.description:
Teachers can cancel only their own upcoming or running reservations; admins any.

**Roles:** TEACHER, ADMIN, CLUB

get.summary: Search rooms with their live status
get.description: Status is computed from reservations at request time. Filters combine with AND.

parameters.name: stepFree
parameters.description: true: only rooms reachable without steps

get.description: Live status, today's schedule, accessibility info and the nearest elevator / accessible toilet (step-free walking distance).

post.description:
Returns up to two options: **fastest** (your constraints) and **step-free** (no stairs or steps), with distance, ETA (walking or wheelchair speed), elevator / ramp counts, GeoJSON per floor and turn-by-turn steps (AR/FR/EN, shoreline hints).

Signed-in users get their accessibility profile applied (disable with `constraints.useProfile: false`). When an option is impossible, `unavailable` explains which constraint blocks it and where.

post.summary: Check progress, detect deviation or closures, reroute
post.description: Send the current position while navigating. Status: ON_ROUTE, ARRIVED, REROUTED (new route included, reason OFF_ROUTE / WRONG_FLOOR / EDGE_CLOSED) or NO_ROUTE (with explanation). Reroutes also emit `route:invalidated` on /live.

get.summary: Which speech features the server provides

post.description: Returns MP3 audio. 503 TTS_UNAVAILABLE when no voice is configured for the language and 502 when the provider fails: clients then use the device voice (speechSynthesis). Results are cached in memory. Limited to 60 requests per minute.

get.description: Returns 503 with status "degraded" when the database does not answer.

kMin.description: Cells seen by fewer distinct people are never returned

byCategory.description: Distinct contributors per category; categories under kMin merged into OTHER

side.description: Relative to the edge from → to

shoreline.description: Nearest wall / curb / railing to follow

evidence.description: Aggregates behind the score (no personal data)

today.description: null when fewer than kMin people (suppressed)

last7d.description: null when fewer than kMin people (suppressed)

AuthSession.description: The refresh token is set as an httpOnly cookie (cw_rt), never returned in the body.

updatedAt.description: null until the user saves a profile

MobilityProfile.description: Self-declared, coarse. Private to the user.

geofence.description: Mobility data is only collected inside it

Geometry.description: GeoJSON geometry, local campus metres [x, y]. With Leaflet CRS.Simple use L.geoJSON directly.

at.description: Instant room statuses were computed for

passages.description: Walkable segments on this level; closed ones have isOpen=false

occupantName.description: Teacher, service or club currently using the room

until.description: Occupied: end of the current reservation. Available: start of the next one within 24 h (null = free for the next 24 h).

freeAt.description: When the room is actually free, following back-to-back reservations (= now when available)

RoomStatusCode.description: AVAILABLE = green/check/solid · TEACHER, ADMIN = red/lock/stripes · CLUB = orange/group/dots

SearchIndex.description: Everything searchable, for instant client-side fuzzy search.

upToDate.description: Granted for the current policy version (required to share)

message.description: Reminder before an automatic stop, or why the session ended

routeId.description: Planned route being followed (from /api/routes/plan). Route ids are random and not linked to an account.

edgeId.description: Passage the report was attached to

note.description: Contact details are redacted. Never shown individually to admins.

routeId.description: Planned route being followed when reporting

organizer.description: Shown as occupantName in room status

ownerId.description: User who created it; null for imported timetable entries

ReservationKind.description: TEACHER/ADMIN show as red (lock), CLUB as orange (group)

organizer.description: Defaults to your display name. Required for CLUB reservations (club name). Teachers cannot set it on TEACHER reservations.

at.description: Instant the statuses were computed for

stepFreeAccess.description: Reachable from the campus gate without any step, through open passages
Reachable from the campus gate without any step, through open passages

wheelchairAccessible.description: Step-free, slope ≤ 8 %, every passage and the door ≥ 80 cm

routeDistanceM.description: Step-free walking distance from the room door

routeId.description: Use with /recheck. null when no option was found.

engine.description: Routing engine that computed the paths

prefilteredConstraints.description: Constraints the engine cannot apply natively, enforced by filtering edges first

hint.description: Original hint from the map data (French)

RouteFloorGeoJson.description: LineStrings per edge (kind, stepIndex), Points for start / end / floor transitions. Campus metres [x, y].

RouteUnavailable.description: Why an option has no route: which constraint blocks it, and where.

mode.description: Default: wheelchair for wheelchair profiles, walking otherwise

RouteLocation.description: A room (its door), a point of interest, a graph node, or a position snapped to the nearest walkable node (≤ 40 m).

useProfile.description: Start from the signed-in user’s accessibility profile (default true)

RouteConstraintsInput.description: Overrides on top of the profile. Closed passages are always excluded.

option.description: Option being followed (default: the first one)
